The other, unnamed clauses of all five base policies are still carried as clauses in force —

### C. `bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding`

**Baseline.** `baseline.rule` is seven sentences; all seven stand in
`cancellation_penalty_computation_442c8294` (role `baseline`), six verbatim and one ("The penalty
withheld is the figure the ladder gives together with the administration charge withheld. The whole
of the figure so reached is withheld") assembling the source's "The whole of the figure reached is
withheld" with the order sentence's "the administration charge is added to what is left of it".
`baseline.params` is `[standing_cancellation_share_pct]`, and the document renders that constant
inline with its policy — "the standing share of the desk's cancellation schedule, **being 10 per
cent**" — together with the operation it performs ("the penalised value multiplied by that share").
Rounding is carried with the no-earlier-rounding gloss and a fractional-cent worked example. The
fall-back is definite: 24,600.00 × 10 % = 2,460.00 on this task's package, which is exactly
`computations[0].baseline_result`.

The order sentence's two factor-specific limbs ("the deposit is ring-fenced out of the figure that
share gives before anything is added" and "the loyalty relief acts last on that sum") are **not**

reached", which the baseline's "the figure so reached" names. The blind audit reached the source's
exact 5,702.63 from those anchors alone, and rejected the alternative order (relief before the
administration charge, 5,705.63) on them.

## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the documents in this task's domain was traced back to a source atom.
The results of the scan for things that have **no** source:

**Additions: none found.** A targeted sweep for "confirm with", "check with", "verify", "notify the
party", "review again", "double-check", "advise the party", "obtain approval" and "escalate"
returns **zero hits** across the whole published bundle corpus. No document adds a calculation, a
condition, a question, a confirmation, a wait, a review, a notification or a step the source does
not carry.

**Rewrites: none found.** Four equivalent restatements that could have shifted a boundary and do
not: `desk_cancellation_schedule_shares_d7945aaa`'s six worked boundary cases (they match the
compute's `<= 14`, `<= 42`, `<= 89` cascade exactly); `administration_charge_on_a_cancellation_a5d91035`'s
"A cancellation confirmed on the due day itself is not later than the due day" (matches the strict
`days_from_due_to_cancellation > 0`); `operator_advices_and_what_stands_withheld_f8a91980`'s "An
ordinary advice issued exactly 90 days before … is within the advice window" (matches
`latest_advice_gap <= advice_window_days`); and `frequent_traveller_penalty_relief_6499dbfc`'s "A
traveller at exactly 6 packages is not more than twice the threshold" (matches
`> threshold * multiple`).

**Omissions: none found.** The untriggered branches were checked explicitly: the 90-per-cent and
55-per-cent bands of the desk schedule and its 90-or-more tier; the part-paid and nothing-put-in
tiers of the penalised value; the deposit-covers-the-ladder tier and the not-returnable tier of the
ring-fence; the on-or-before-the-due-day tiers of the administration charge; the half-relief and
no-relief tiers; the deposit-not-returnable tier and the "otherwise" tier of the money put in; the
significant-change tier and the no-advice tier of the operator advice; the half-goodwill and
no-card tiers; and the some-but-not-all and none tiers of the currency retention — none of which
this seed hits, and all of which are carried in full with their figures.

**The two prerequisite-specific checks.**

1. **Cross-problem operational guidance: absent.** No clause anywhere reads "if unsatisfied, please
   call <tool> first" or anything meaning that. `condition`, `resolved_by`, `effect`, `kind` and
   `gate` are nowhere rendered as text.
2. **A task's opening world state written in as a policy fact: absent.** A sweep for "currently",
   "at present", "this customer", "as things stand", "right now" returns **zero hits**. No document
   says that a package stands cancelled without a penalty, that a room upgrade stands on a ledger,
   that payments were taken in euro, or that a traveller holds a Titanium card. Every illustration
   is on hypothetical particulars and none reproduces this task's scored figures: the penalty
   computation works a price of 5,000.00, the penalised value works 5,000.00 / 640.00, the
   ring-fence works a ladder of 3,200.00, the administration charge works 2 adults and 2 children
   at 100.00, the relief works a figure of 2,000.00, the money put in works 2,000.00 / 5,000.00 /
   600.00, the operator advice works 1,020.00 at 30 days, the goodwill works 1,020.00 at 6 per
   cent, and the retention works 3,000.00 at 3.0 per cent — against this task's 24,600.00 /
   25,930.00 / 7,779.00 / 100.00 / 5,879.00 / 2,851.315 / 199.59205. Where an example's *shape*

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No `KB-BIJECTION RED`.

Affected documents and locations: none. Relation to previous revisions: this is revision 1 for this
difficulty; no earlier `policy_kb/vacation_packages_desk/` revision exists.

**Policy-side note (recorded as required, and not affecting this skill's verdict).**

Both of this task's `baseline.rule`s open by naming inputs their own baseline method never uses.
`bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding`'s opens "worked out from the desk's own cancellation
schedule, **the money the party had put into the package** and **the traveller's record with the
traveller club**", while its baseline takes the penalised value as the package price and applies no
relief; `bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout`'s opens "worked out from what the party put into the
package, what stands withheld against it, **the currency the party elected to be charged in** and
**the traveller's standing with the traveller club**". The named inputs are the evidence of four
declared factors. The render contract requires the baseline rule to be carried complete in the
computation document, so `cancellation_penalty_computation_442c8294` and
`refund_settlement_computation_7d4048a1` carry these sentences verbatim, as they must. The mild
signal that something can turn on those inputs therefore originates in the source's own baseline,
not in the rendering — the sentences name no factor, no document, no tool and no class of customer,
and both fall-back figures remain definite and match the source's own `baseline_result`. This is
reported as a policy-side observation, not as a defect of the documents, and it does not change
this skill's verdict. The refund baseline is the milder of the two, since it goes on to state a
default for both named slots ("Nothing is added back … Nothing is retained …").
